$comment: Dev agent permissions. It may write code and run both test suites, but it may NOT publish: git push, git remote and gh are denied, so only automation/dev.mjs can put anything on GitHub. A runaway or confused run has no path to the remote. Deletion is denied outright rather than by flag pattern, because 'rm -rf' as a prefix rule misses rm -fr, rm -r -f and a plain rm; 'git rm' is deliberately absent from both lists so a legitimate file removal prompts you instead. Note the allow list IS the unprompted surface: anything missing from it stops and asks, which is why node, npx and npm install were removed rather than denied - you can still approve one when a ticket genuinely calls for it. None of this contains a determined agent, which is impossible while it can write files and run a build; it is here to stop accidents. The model is pinned here rather than passed as a flag for the same reason the permissions are - it is the one input that decides the quality of everything below, and left unset it drifts silently when the CLI default moves or when a /model set in some earlier session carries over.
